source_name: North Dakota Secretary of State - Voting in North Dakota
as_of_notes: North Dakota has no voter registration, so there are no registered-voter counts at any level. The equivalent metric provided is ballots cast in the most recent statewide election (General Election, November 5, 2024). The statewide_value (371,975 total ballots cast; 62.61% turnout of 594,140 estimated eligible voters) is the official figure certified by the State Canvassing Board (ND SOS, certified Nov 20, 2024). County-level values are TOTAL VOTES CAST IN THE PRESIDENTIAL CONTEST by county from the certified 2024 results; these are a close proxy for ballots cast by county but are slightly understated relative to total ballots cast because of presidential undervotes/skips (county presidential total sums to 368,155 vs. 371,975 total ballots statewide). ND SOS does not publish a single static county-level 'ballots cast' table; the official interactive results portal (results.sos.nd.gov) reports county figures only via per-county selection.
notes: OFFICIAL CONFIRMATION: The North Dakota Secretary of State states, 'North Dakota does not require voter registration, but you do need to have a valid form of identification that can be used for voting,' and 'North Dakota is the only state without voter registration as our Voter ID Law requires a valid form of ID to vote.' (https://www.sos.nd.gov/elections/voter/voting-north-dakota). Because ND has no voter registration, there are NO registered-voter counts statewide or by county; statewide_total_registered, statewide_by_party, and the counties[] (registration) array are null/empty by design, and county_level_available is false (for registration). This is consistent with the EAC EAVS, which lists ND registration as N/A. EQUIVALENT PROVIDED (NOT registration): ballots cast / turnout. Statewide = 371,975 ballots cast (62.61% turnout) in the November 5, 2024 General Election, per the ND SOS State Canvassing Board certification (https://www.sos.nd.gov/news/state-canvassing-board-certifies-general-election-results) and the official results portal (https://results.sos.nd.gov/Default.aspx?map=Cty). County-level equivalent values are total votes cast in the 2024 presidential contest by county (53 counties), a close but slightly understated proxy for ballots cast (presidential county total = 368,155 due to undervotes). No registration figures were fabricated.
